q1.explanationZh: advantage 名词“优势；好处”，也可作及物动词“有利于”；take advantage of“利用”。

q2.explanationZh: adventure 名词“冒险（经历）”，也可作动词“冒险”；注意结尾是 -ture。

q3.explanationZh: advertise“做广告”，也可拼作 advertize；advertise for“登广告征求”。

q4.explanationZh: advertise 加 -ment 构成名词 advertisement“广告”，口语中常缩略为 ad。

q5.explanationZh: advice 是名词（不可数），结尾是 -ce；动词是 advise。

q6.explanationZh: advise 是动词，结尾是 -se；名词是 advice。

q7.explanationZh: advocate 作动词“提倡”，作名词“拥护者”，两种词性读音不同。

q8.explanationZh: aeroplane 是英式英语的“飞机”，美式用 airplane。

q9.explanationZh: affair“事务；事件”，复数 affairs 可表示“私事”。

q10.explanationZh: affect 是及物动词“影响”，注意不要与名词 effect“影响；效果”混淆。

q11.explanationZh: affect 加 -ion 构成名词 affection，常指“喜爱；感情”。

q12.explanationZh: afford“买得起；负担得起”，常用 can afford (to do) sth.；形容词 affordable。

q13.explanationZh: afraid 是形容词，一般作表语，如 be afraid of / be afraid to do。

q14.explanationZh: Africa“非洲”是专有名词，首字母要大写。

q15.explanationZh: after 可作介词或连词，表示“在……之后”（时间先后）。

q16.explanationZh: afternoon = after + noon，“中午之后”就是“下午”。

q17.explanationZh: afterward 也可写作 afterwards，都是副词“后来”。

q18.explanationZh: again 副词“再一次；又”，again and again“反复地”。

q19.explanationZh: against 是介词，基本意思是“反对；对着”，be against“反对”。

q20.explanationZh: age 作名词“年龄”，作动词“变老”；at the age of“在……岁时”。

q21.explanationZh: aged 是形容词“年老的”，the aged 指“老年人”。

q22.explanationZh: agency“代理处；机构”，指人的“代理人”是 agent。

q23.explanationZh: agenda“议事日程”，put sth. on the agenda“把某事提上日程”。

q24.explanationZh: agent 指“代理人；代理商”，机构“代理处”是 agency。

q25.explanationZh: aggressive 形容词“侵略的；积极进取的”，注意双写 g 和 s。

q26.explanationZh: ago 表示“（从现在算起）……以前”，放在时间段之后，如 two days ago，常与一般过去时连用。

q27.explanationZh: agree“同意”，反义词 disagree；名词 agreement。

q28.explanationZh: agree 加 -able 构成形容词 agreeable“令人愉快的”。

q29.explanationZh: agree 加 -ment 构成名词 agreement“协议”。

q31.explanationZh: ahead 副词“在前面”，ahead of“在……之前”。

q32.explanationZh: AI 是 artificial intelligence（人工智能）的缩写，两个字母都大写。

q33.explanationZh: aid 作名词“帮助；辅助物”，作动词“援助”；first aid“急救”。

q34.explanationZh: agree on sth.“就某事取得一致意见”，介词用 on。

q35.explanationZh: agree to 后接表示“建议、安排、计划”等的名词，表示“同意（某个意见）”。

q36.explanationZh: agree with sb.“同意某人的看法”，也可表示（气候、食物等）“适合”。

q37.explanationZh: have the advantage of“有……的好处（优势）”。

q38.explanationZh: take advantage of sth.“利用（机会等）”，advantage 前不加冠词。

q39.explanationZh: advertise for“登广告征求（招聘）……”，介词用 for。

q40.explanationZh: give advice on/about sth.“提出有关某事的建议”，advice 不可数。

q41.explanationZh: “接受某人的建议”= take/follow one’s advice。

q42.explanationZh: ask for“请求，征求”，ask for one’s advice“向某人征求意见”。

q43.explanationZh: refuse“拒绝”，refuse one’s advice“拒绝某人的建议”。

q44.explanationZh: advise sb. to do sth.“劝某人做某事”，后接不定式。

q45.explanationZh: be afraid of doing sth.“对……害怕，担心；害怕可能发生的某种后果”，介词用 of，后接动名词。原书答案印作 be afraid of sth.，与题干释义不符，经人工复核（GitHub #136）更正为 be afraid of doing sth.。

q46.explanationZh: be afraid to do sth.“因为害怕而不敢做某事”，后接不定式。

q47.explanationZh: agreeable to the ear“悦耳的”，agreeable 意为“令人愉快的”。

q48.explanationZh: ahead of“在……之前”，ahead of time“提前”。

q49.explanationZh: “支付每月日常开销之后还能存点钱”，介词 after 后接动名词 paying。

q50.explanationZh: aid sb. with sth.“用……帮助某人”，叙述过去的事用过去式 aided。

q51.explanationZh: an employment agency“职业介绍所”，agency“代理处；机构”。

q52.explanationZh: advise sb. to do sth.“建议某人做某事”，叙述过去用 advised。

q53.explanationZh: private affairs“私事”，表示“私事”时 affair 用复数。

q54.explanationZh: age 作动词“变老”，主语 he 后需要谓语，过去式 aged。

q55.explanationZh: be afraid to do sth.“不敢做某事”，was 后用形容词 afraid。

q56.explanationZh: agree that...“同意……”，主语 We 用动词原形 agree。

q57.explanationZh: and 连接 allow 和 advocate，都跟在 must 后，用原形 advocate“提倡”。

q58.explanationZh: struggle against“与……作斗争”，against 是介词。

q59.sampleAnswer: It is because some young people pursue uniqueness that they turn to overseas purchasing agents to satisfy their personalized consumption needs.
references: It is because some young people pursue uniqueness that they turn to overseas purchasing agents to satisfy their personalized consumption needs.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q59.explanationZh: “正是因为……”用强调句 It is because... that...；“海外代购”= overseas purchasing agents；“求助于”= turn to。

q60.sampleAnswer: An English-Chinese dictionary is an important aid in learning English.
references: An English-Chinese dictionary is an important aid in learning English.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: aid 作名词可指“辅助物，工具”，an important aid in learning English“学习英语的重要工具”。

q61.sampleAnswer: After attending the ancient book restoration workshop, I realised that the seemingly simple process requires the combined application of patience and skills.
references: After attending the ancient book restoration workshop, I realised that the seemingly simple process requires the combined application of patience and skills.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: “……之后”用 After doing...；“看似简单的”= seemingly simple；“双重打磨”可译为 the combined application。

q62.sampleAnswer: He took advantage of her ignorance, and made off with her money.
references: He took advantage of her ignorance, and made off with her money.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: “利用”= take advantage of，叙述过去用 took；“带着……逃走”= make off with。

q63.sampleAnswer: They know that this opportunity doesn’t come easy, so they work together, develop creative thinking and resolve to build their hometown into a model village with intelligent agriculture at its core.
references: They know that this opportunity doesn’t come easy, so they work together, develop creative thinking and resolve to build their hometown into a model village with intelligent agriculture at its core.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: “来之不易”= doesn’t come easy；“把……建设成……”= build... into...；“以智慧农业为核心”= with intelligent agriculture at its core。

q64.sampleAnswer: Everyone has come to an agreement that a noble personality as well as a strong body and a sharp mind is one of the requirements that young people today should meet to become talents.
references: Everyone has come to an agreement that a noble personality as well as a strong body and a sharp mind is one of the requirements that young people today should meet to become talents.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: “大家一致认为”= Everyone has come to an agreement that...；A as well as B 作主语时谓语与 A 一致，用 is。

q65.sampleAnswer: According to the advice from educators and experts, parents can have a better understanding of children’s psychology and personality.
references: According to the advice from educators and experts, parents can have a better understanding of children’s psychology and personality.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “根据”= according to；“建议”用不可数名词 advice；“更好地了解”= have a better understanding of。

q66.sampleAnswer: Educators generally believe that negative attitudes towards study will affect students’ attention in class.
references: Educators generally believe that negative attitudes towards study will affect students’ attention in class.
Educators generally believe that negative attitudes to study will affect students’ attention in class.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: “影响”用及物动词 affect，后面直接接宾语；“对……的态度”= attitude(s) towards/to...。

q67.sampleAnswer: As far as I know, predicting specific quakes ahead of time has been a goal difficult to achieve.
references: As far as I know, predicting specific quakes ahead of time has been a goal difficult to achieve.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: “据我所知”= as far as I know；“提前”= ahead of time；动名词短语 predicting... 作主语。

q68.sampleAnswer: If an advertisement claims that a certain medicine can cure anybody of any disease, it must be false.
references: If an advertisement claims that a certain medicine can cure anybody of any disease, it must be false.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q68.explanationZh: “广告”= advertisement，元音开头用 an；“治愈某人的疾病”= cure sb. of a disease；“肯定是”用 must。
